svg.title: Axis conventions in common engines
svg.desc: Two hands make the axis sign: thumb +X pointing right, index finger +Y up, middle finger +Z. On the right hand, palm toward you, the middle finger points at you; on the left hand, back toward you, it points away. Below them, a two-by-two chart. Rows: Y up, Z up. Columns: right-handed, left-handed. Odyssey is right-handed with Y up and forward along -Z, like Bevy, Godot, three.js, and OpenGL. Unity is left-handed with Y up and forward along +Z. Blender is right-handed with Z up and forward along -Y. Unreal Engine is left-handed with Z up and forward along +X.
svg.text: Same thumb and index finger, mirrored hand: only the middle finger, Z, changes direction.
